ui.title: Interface
desc: The icons used inside buttons and interface elements are taken from the official websites of the respective companies whenever possible.
When official SVG files are not available, most of them come from Iconify, which collects icons from many open-source sets.
All rights remain with the respective owners and authors. The source, author and license of each icon are listed below.
